sentences.en: Shame on you for getting so flustered. You looked ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 1. 别因为你慌乱成那样而羞愧。你看起来很可笑。

sentences.en: Yanni was flustered but tried to be polite.
sentences.zh: 2. 耶anni感到狼狈，但还是尽量保持礼貌。

sentences.en: She got all flustered when the boy she likes came over to talk to her.
sentences.zh: 3. 当她喜欢的那个男孩过来跟她说话时，她变得非常紧张和混乱。
